name: Smash Beat Fit: XR Cardio Workout
summary:
# ⚡ Punch to the Beat. Break Through a Virtual Wall!

Looking for a quick, active VR experience with music, motion, and satisfying visual action?

Step into a rhythm punching game where notes fly toward you from multiple directions.  
Hit them to the beat, stay focused, and watch a virtual wall in your room crack open with every punch.

Beyond the opening, a different world begins to appear: scenic skies and natural landscapes waiting just beyond your room.
